source.note: known-divergences/tokenless-empty-forms.md, The difference: mermaid.js reads nothing for the empty string at the start of the label, which this specification rejects; the empty description block after the vertex is followed by its separator, and the one after the empty line starts a statement, so they stay in the reference input, which is read as the units of the input other than the empty string, and mermaid.js gives it the same Db.
